answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake and a hardware-backed, one-per-device identity proof before it can trade, like a wharf charging each ship once to dock. Reputation then grows slowly, layer by layer like crystal, so a new clone has no history to spend. Fraud slashes the stake and burns that identity, so an attacker chasing basalt-solid influence must pay real money and time for every fake, turning a cheap sybil flood into a slow, expensive trickle honest agents can ignore.
